note: Curated supplementary examples; a few intentionally extend Level 1 for natural contexts. Original book-card examples are used when available.

吧.note: A sentence-final particle that softens a suggestion; usually pronounced neutral tone.

本.note: 本 is a measure word for books; use it between a number and 书.

半.note: Say the hour + 点半; never add 分 after 半.

包子.en: I eat steamed buns in the morning.
包子.note: A food noun; the second syllable is neutral tone.

白天.note: 白天 is the daytime, contrasting with 晚上 (evening/night).

超市.en: I go to the supermarket to buy water.
超市.note: 超市 is a supermarket; 商店 is a more general shop.

穿.note: Use 穿 for putting on/wearing clothing.

大学.note: 大学 = university. 大学生 = university student.

大学生.en: My older brother is a university student.
大学生.note: The noun 大学生 literally combines university + student.

到.en: I arrive at school at eight.
到.note: 到 describes reaching a destination; 去 describes going there.

第.note: 第 + number gives ordinal numbers: 第一 means first.

弟弟.note: Chinese kinship terms distinguish older and younger siblings.

电影院.en: I go to the cinema to watch a movie.
电影院.note: 电影院 is the place; 电影 is the movie.

给.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.
给.en: Please give me a cup of water.
给.note: 给 can mean 'give' or 'for/to'; watch the word order.

公司.en: My dad works at a company.
公司.note: Use 在 + place + 工作 to say where someone works.

便宜.note: Second syllable is neutral tone: piányi.

还.en: I still want to drink tea.
还.note: 还 (hái) can mean 'still' or 'also'; meaning depends on context.

好吃.note: 好吃 describes food; 好喝 describes drinks.

好看.note: 好看 describes appearance or something enjoyable to watch.

好听.note: 好听 describes sounds or music, not food.

好玩儿.note: 儿 marks an -r ending (érhuà) in this vocabulary entry.

火车.en: I take the train to Beijing.
火车.note: 坐 + vehicle is how you travel; 开车 means to drive.

鸡蛋.note: 鸡蛋 literally means chicken egg.

家人.note: 家 is home/family; 家人 refers to family members.

饺子.note: 饺子 is a kind of dumpling; 子 here is neutral tone.

觉得.py: Wǒ juéde Hànyǔ hěn yǒu yìsi.
觉得.note: 觉得 expresses an opinion or feeling. (This example extends the Level 1 word pool.)

开车.note: 会 is a learned ability; 开车 = drive a car.

看见.note: 看 is looking/watching; 看见 emphasizes actually seeing.

看病.en: She goes to the hospital to see a doctor.
看病.note: 看病 means seeking medical attention; 看 is not literally 'look at' here.

课.en: I have Chinese class in the morning.
课.note: 课 is a class or lesson; 上课 means attend class.

两.note: 两 normally goes before a measure word; 二 is used in counting and many numbers.

卖.note: 买 (mǎi, third tone) = buy; 卖 (mài, fourth tone) = sell.

没事.note: 没事 is conversational reassurance. (Example uses words outside Level 1.)

面条儿.note: The -r ending is part of the published entry.

哪个.note: 哪 + measure word can ask which one.

哪些.note: 哪些 asks which ones (plural), whereas 哪个 asks which one.

男朋友.note: 朋友 is a friend; 男朋友 often means boyfriend.

女朋友.note: 女朋友 often means girlfriend; 女 = female.

呢.note: 呢 is used for follow-up questions or an ongoing situation; it is neutral tone.

您.note: 您 is a respectful form of 你.

女士.note: 女士 is a polite title, used after the surname.

千.py: Zhèlǐ yǒu yì qiān ge rén.
千.en: There are one thousand people here.
千.note: 千 = one thousand; 百 = hundred.

请问.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
请问.note: 请问 is polite before asking someone a question. (Some words extend Level 1.)

上班.note: 上班 = go to/start work; 下班 = finish work.

上学.en: The children go to school at eight.
上学.note: 上学 = attend/go to school; 上课 = attend class.

手机.note: 手机 is a mobile phone; 电话 can refer to a telephone or call.

书店.en: I go to the bookstore to buy a book.

睡.note: 睡 and 睡觉 are related; 睡觉 is a common verb meaning sleep.

它.note: 它 (it), 他 (he), and 她 (she) are pronounced tā.

他.note: 他/她/它 all sound tā but are different characters.

她.note: 她 and 他 sound identical; characters show gender.

外边.en: The cat is outside the room.

晚饭.py: Wǒmen wǎnshang qī diǎn chī wǎnfàn.
晚饭.en: We eat dinner at seven in the evening.
晚饭.note: 晚饭 = dinner; 早饭 = breakfast, 午饭 = lunch.

问.py: Wǒ xiǎng wèn yí ge wèntí.
问.en: I want to ask a question.
问.note: 问 is to ask; 问题 is the question.

问题.py: Lǎoshī wèn wǒ yí ge wèntí.
问题.en: The teacher asks me a question.
问题.note: 问题 can mean a question or a problem.

小朋友.en: The little child is at school.
小朋友.note: This term refers to children, not necessarily a small-sized friend.

雪.note: 下雪 = snow (verb phrase); 雪 is snow.

一半.note: 一 changes tone before fourth-tone words: yíbàn.

有点儿.en: I am a little busy today.
有点儿.note: 有点儿 often describes a slightly undesirable state; 一点儿 means a small amount.

正在.note: 正在 before a verb marks an activity in progress.

知道.note: 知道 is knowing facts; 认识 is knowing or being acquainted with someone.

坐.note: 坐 = sit or ride; 做 = do or make. Both are zuò.

做.note: 做 = do/make; 坐 = sit/ride, pronounced the same.

在.note: 在 = location; 再 = again, both pronounced zài.

再.note: 再 means again; 在 indicates location or ongoing action. (一次 extends Level 1.)
